## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new script and test suite to generate deduped, controlled page-level mark scheme screenshot assets, enforcing strict delivery and retention boundaries. Feedback from the code review suggests several robustness improvements: dynamically resolving package paths instead of using hardcoded absolute paths, wrapping rendering and document operations in try...finally blocks to guarantee resource cleanup, and filtering collections to record-only entries before processing, aggregating, or validating to prevent potential TypeErrors.
